intro.fr: Santa Needs YOU! se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Santa Needs YOU! can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub Ishigh1/Santa_AP, qui héberge l'APWorld de Santa Needs YOU!.
text.en: The GitHub repository Ishigh1/Santa_AP, home of the Santa Needs YOU! APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la version 1.1.4, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (6 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 1.1.4 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (6 versions released).

text.fr: Santa Needs YOU! figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Santa Needs YOU! is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
